1.web: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
1.asv: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.

2.web: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
2.asv: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.

3.web: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
3.asv: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.

4.web: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
4.asv: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

5.web: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
5.asv: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.

6.web: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh;
6.asv: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;

7.web: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all your wondrous works.
7.asv: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.

8.web: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
8.asv: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.

9.web: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
9.asv: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;

10.web: in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
10.asv: In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.

11.web: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
11.asv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

12.web: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
12.asv: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah.
